device.description: 12-bit 200-kSPS 11-channel low-power serial ADC with programmable output length/order, unipolar or bipolar output and EOC
device.note: tlv2553.pdf (SLAS354C) p.3 pin configuration and functions, p.5 recommended operating conditions, p.6 tconvert, p.8-9 timing requirements (VREF+ = 5 V and 2.5 V), p.9-12 Figures 1-6, p.22 converter operation, data I/O cycle and power up, p.23 Table 2 command set (CMR) and CFGR1, p.23-24 data length, LSB first, bipolar, EOC, p.25 CS and power down; same content in tlv2553-q1.pdf (TLV2553-Q1)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: CMR (D7-D4) and CFGR1 (D3-D0) of the input data register (Table 2, p.23); set to all zeroes at power up (p.22)

commands.name: Reserved (1111b)
commands.note: Table 2 (p.23): 1111b reserved; it has no access to CFGR1 (p.23); ignored

commands.name: Software power down (address 1110), 8-bit I/O cycle
commands.note: Table 2 (p.23) / p.25: command 1110b selects software power down; no conversion is performed, the I/O cycle must still be completed

commands.name: Software power down (address 1110), 12-bit I/O cycle
commands.note: Table 2 (p.23) / p.25: command 1110b selects software power down; no conversion is performed, the I/O cycle must still be completed

commands.name: Select channel / test voltage, 8-bit I/O cycle
commands.note: Table 2 (p.23): D7-D4 command (0000b-1010b AIN0-AIN10, 1011b-1101b self-test), CFGR1 D3-D2 output length (01 = 8, x0 = 12, 11 = 16), D1 LSB first, D0 bipolar 2s complement; the conversion starts after the last (8th/12th/16th) I/O CLOCK falling edge (p.22-24)

pages: p.3 (pins), p.5 (ROC), p.6 (tconvert 5.54 us at 2.7-3.6 V), p.9 (timing at VCC = 2.7 V: td1 30 ns, td2 10 ns, td3 33 ns, td4 75 ns), p.22 (operation, power up), p.23 (Table 2), p.23-24 (data length, LSB first, bipolar, EOC), p.25 (CS, power down)
notModeled: analog inputs, references and multiplexer: every conversion returns the 0 V code (unipolar 000h; bipolar (CFGR1 D0 = 1) 800h, the code of VREF- = 0 V, which the datasheet calls 2s complement relative to (VREF+ + VREF-)/2: modeled as codeFormat offset)
self-test commands 1011b/1100b/1101b output 2048/0/4095 (p.7): modeled as conversions returning the 0 V code; reserved command 1111b is ignored
software power down (1110b) and the power-down state after power on, auto power down: modeled as an I/O cycle that starts no conversion
data length: CFGR1 D3-D2 applies to the current I/O cycle; MSB-first output is the same for every length (12 result bits then zeros), LSB-first ordering uses the length and LSBF of the previous cycle
result pipelining (output is the previous conversion, first result after power up random): the result is constant
CS held low continuously (first bit at EOC rising, DATA OUT forced low during conversion): only CS-framed transfers are modeled
conversion start: after the last I/O CLOCK falling edge with EOC falling td4 75 ns later; modeled at the last rising edge (command completion)
CS abort of a conversion (td5 1.5 us), CS debounce
timing at VCC = 2.7 V, VREF+ = 2.5 V (p.9): tValid = td1 30 ns (25 pF), tOut = td3 33 ns, tFloat = td2 10 ns
variants: tlv2553.pdf covers TLV2553I (DW, PW); tlv2553-q1.pdf covers TLV2553-Q1 (IPWRQ1) with the same pinout and interface.
